Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Brand activation timeline + initial rigging ask

Team / Angela —

Putting this thread together to lock the high-level activation timeline for CloudCon (booth C12). Key asks before we commit print and AV:

- Confirm heavy-rigging window (we need truss install for a 10ft header + two suspended panels). Proposed window: Tue 6/25 18:00–22:00.
- Sign-off on 30-min "Brand Moment" cadence during exhibit hours (we want 4x daily product demos + 2x 15-min spotlight segments).
- Final floorplan attached (floorplan_v7.pdf) — note updated electrical drops and demo pit.
- Inventory for the welcome kits attached will land in the show crate; need a crate owner and day-of pickup plan.

Marissa — can you confirm AV weight limits and whether the truss requires a venue rigging permit?
Karthik — can you confirm staffing for the four demo slots and two spotlight moments (we'll need at least 2 SDRs + 1 engineer per demo).
Connor — can you take point on crate manifest + freight timeline with FreightCo and confirm dock slot reservation?
Angela — any issues with the proposed evening rigging window or insurance paperwork?

Goal: final sign-off by EOD Thu 6/21 so we can print signage Friday morning.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Sr. Field Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Angela Park <angela@eventsupply.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Brand activation timeline + initial rigging ask

Thanks Steph — looping AV and production notes below.

Quick updates:
- AV: the proposed truss will exceed standard exhibitor rigging if we suspend the two panels; if panels are laminate (non-rigged) we're OK. If we need the truss, venue requires a structural calc + a 48-hour lead on rigging crew.
- Proposed alternate: mount two lightweight fabric banners to the backwall (looks similar in photos) — saves the rigging permit and ~6 hours of install.
- Brand moment cadence: 4 demos/day looks good; recommend we stagger start times to avoid queue pileups (10:30, 13:00, 15:30, 17:00) with 15-min spotlight at 12:15 and 16:15.
- Welcome kit inventory attached; looks like 280 kits total. If we prep 300 we'll cover staff/sample swaps.

I attached welcome_kit_inventory.xlsx and added FreightCo contact (ops@freightco.com) in the sheet.

If we decide to keep the truss, we need an explicit venue sign-off (they'll want load specs and our COI).

-Marissa
Director, Events & Field Marketing
Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Brand activation timeline + initial rigging ask

Hi all —

Thanks for the details. Venue production here — quick confirmations:

- The evening rigging window Tue 6/25 18:00–22:00 is available but will be classified as "after-hours" and carries a premium (see attached insurance_certificate_requirements.pdf for required limits).
- For truss: we require a third-party structural calc no later than 6/23 and a COI naming Moscone Center & Redwood Inference as additional insured. DocuSign link for the insurance addendum: https://www.docusign.com/envelope/ABC123-brand-activation-insurance
- Dock slots: FreightCo can use Dock 4 (arrival window Wed 6/26 06:00–09:00) — early arrival is fine but anything before 06:00 needs advance security.

If you pivot to the fabric banners we can drop the structural calc requirement and keep rigging within standard exhibitor install.

Happy to schedule a 15-min call today to walk the options.

Best,
Angela Park
Senior Production Manager
EventSupply Co.

Date: Fri, 21 Jun 2028 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Brand activation timeline + initial rigging ask — final next steps

Thanks everyone — quick decisions to lock prints and freight: 

1) We will NOT pursue the truss route — we'll move to fabric banners mounted to the backwall to avoid structural calc and after-hours fees. Marissa: please confirm final dielines by 6/22 10:00 so print can go overnight.
2) Connor: take point on the crate manifest and confirm FreightCo Dock 4 arrival slot (Wed 6/26 06:00–09:00). Provide the tracking reference by EOD Mon 6/24.
3) Karthik: staffing confirmed (2 SDRs + 1 Eng per demo slot), please send shift sheet with contact cell numbers by Tue 6/25 12:00.
4) Angela: thanks for the insurance callout — since we removed the truss we'll only need the standard COI; please confirm any other production permits we should factor in.

If we get the dielines and crate manifest on time, signage prints Friday AM and kits ship Saturday. I'll post a short run-of-show once Marissa confirms the final timeslots.
